help.title: Chat – Help
help.intro: In the chat you write directly (1:1) or in group rooms with several people and share files, photos, locations and surveys.

mention.desc: In group chats, the list of room members opens as you type. ↑↓ select an entry, Enter or Tab insert it, Escape closes the list again without changing the text you entered. In direct chats @ remains plain text.
mention.descMobile: In group chats, the list of room members opens as you type. Tap an entry to insert it. In direct chats @ remains plain text.

mentionRoom.desc: Notifies all members of the room. The entry appears directly after the @ and again as soon as you have typed three characters – the short forms @team, @all and @alle find the same entry and also insert @room.

mentionMe.desc: Inserts your own name as text without notifying yourself. The entry only appears with the exact input @me – @m or @mei do not show it.

date.desc: Opens the date picker and inserts the chosen date.

location.desc: Opens the location picker and shares the chosen place.

send.desc: Sends the message. If the @ list is still open, Enter selects the highlighted entry instead.

sendMobile.desc: Your message is only sent once you tap the send button at the bottom right.

newline.desc: Inserts a new line without sending the message.

newlineMobile.desc: Inserts a new line. On phones and tablets Enter does not send the message.

chats.title: Types of chat
chats.group: Group chat — belongs to a group and is created automatically. The group's members are in it.
chats.direct: Direct chat — a private conversation between you and one other person.
chats.adhoc: Ad-hoc chat — a room for a particular occasion that you set up yourself with several people, for example for support or an emergency.
chats.announcement: Announcements — only the club's officials write here, everyone else reads along.
chats.pinboard: Notice board — everyone can post something for all. Replies go privately to the person who wrote the notice.
chats.personal: Personal chat — only you can see «Notes to self». Messages you keep with «Save» land here, with a reminder if you like. You can also write your own notes.

info.rules: Here you can share something with everyone: sell, rent out or give away something, look for people to ride along with, or report a find. All members receive a notification. When you reply to a notice, your reply goes only to the person who wrote it, as a direct message. The others do not read along. So you do not need to put a phone number or address in a notice.
info.rulesReplyAll: Here you can share something with everyone: sell, rent out or give away something, look for people to ride along with, or report a find. All members receive a notification. When you reply to a notice, your reply normally goes only to the person who wrote it, as a direct message. You can also reply to everyone; then all members receive a notification. So do not put a phone number or address in a notice.

convert.label: Convert into a group
convert.message: This chat becomes a real group with a member list. Everyone currently in it stays, and no message is lost. The chat stays closed — only members can enter, and anyone joining later reads along from that point on. What else should the group get?

log.title: Matrix SDK log level
log.description: Controls how verbosely the Matrix SDK (matrix-js-sdk) writes to the browser console – for chat troubleshooting only. The selection is retained across reloads. Default: warn. Set to trace/debug for verbose logs, to silent for none.

names.label: Repair display names
names.description: Sets missing Matrix display names from the person name (first name last name). Accounts with their own name remain untouched.
names.none: All display names are correct – nothing to repair.
names.skipped_custom: Accounts with their own display name skipped.
names.confirm: Set {{ count }} display names from the person names now?

avatars.label: Repair avatars
avatars.description: Sets missing Matrix avatars from the person avatar. Accounts with their own avatar remain untouched.

guests.label: Non-members in group chats
guests.description: Shows, per group, how many people sit in the chat room without being on the member list, and flags the affected rooms in the list. Nothing is changed here.
guests.none: Every group chat holds members only — nothing to do.
guests.link_text: Syncing members, setting write permissions and removing non-members are in the menu of the group list.

assign.label: Assign rooms by hand
assign.description: Some chat rooms belong to no group — for example rooms created by a connection to Signal or WhatsApp. The automatic assignment cannot recognise them, so you decide here: rooms you assign to this app appear in the chat overview; hidden rooms appear in no app. Either way they stay readable in Element.
assign.none: Every room is assigned – nothing to do.
assign.confirm_here: Assign the room “{{ name }}” to this app? It will then appear in the chat overview.
assign.confirm_hide: Hide the room “{{ name }}”? It will then appear in no app.
